QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Aruhi's Sincerity
QuestInfo.0:
While Aruhi was hunting with you, he mentioned the abductor again. He may have just been saying it to get people's attention, but he insisted it was all completely true.
You should check out his story to see how much truth there is to it.
